title: pvGenerateGlobalIds
body:
## pvGenerateGlobalIds

Deprecated alias of pvGlobalPointAndCellIds (renamed in ParaView 5.13, removal planned for 5.14): generates global point and cell ids consistent across blocks and processes and flags duplicated points as ghosts. Prefer pvGlobalPointAndCellIds for new workflows.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Expect this operation to disappear when Schemaxis absorbs ParaView 5.14.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateGlobalIds`. Identity: `filters/GenerateGlobalIds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Tolerance` | Set the tolerance to use to identify coincident points. 0 means the points should be exactly identical. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},

  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,

}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGenerateGlobalIds",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
